title: pleroma semidecandrum
intro: Pleroma semidecandrum, commonly known as the lesser bird's eye, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Pleroma semidecandrum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as treating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
